summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its monthly Hong Kong Stock Exchange return (equivalent to a routine US current report on share-capital movements) for October 2026, submitted November 5, 2026. Authorized capital is unchanged at 4.5bn Class A and 500m Class B weighted-voting ordinary shares, par USD 0.00001. Issued Class A shares total 972,508,041 including 40,454,099 treasury shares; Class B totals 54,814,423; no month-over-month change. The company confirms compliance with the 15% minimum public float. No transaction, price, board recommendation, or advisor disclosed; watch for future equity issuance or overhang from the treasury block.
